Title: Antimalarial activity (MMV Data)
Description: Predicts in vitro antimalarial activity against the Plasmodium falciparum NF54 strain, reporting results from two readouts, a lactate dehydrogenase assay and a luminescence assay, each at a 1 uM threshold. Ersilia built the models on experimental screening data contributed by Medicines for Malaria Venture. Running two independent detection methods on the same biology guards against assay-specific artefacts, so agreement between the outputs is more convincing than either alone.
Interpretation: Probability of Plasmodium falciparum NF54 inhibition at 1 uM in lactate dehydrogenase and luminescence assays.
